title: Absolutely loved the perfume scent- didn't like the price.
text: The perfume itself is absolutely delicious! Love the scent! Love the little bottle atomizer thing it comes in however....the price for the monthly subscription is just too high. + I found a very similar subscription ( not quite as large of a sample) & it's price is more reasonable. If the price for the subscription ever changes- I will definitely reconsider.
label: positive
